primary_metric_exact_name: subject-equal mean of per-subject medians of per-frame observed-to-exact-triangle surface median distance
pipeline: For each frame, compute one-sided distance from every fixed observed Camera-B person point to the nearest exact MHR mesh triangle.
Reduce point distances to that frame's median.
For each subject, take the median of its three frame medians.
Take the arithmetic mean across subjects, giving every subject equal weight.

tail_contract.subject_p90: P90 across the subject values described above; with five subjects this is descriptive only.
tail_contract.within_frame_p90: For every frame take point-distance P90, then median across frames per subject, then mean across subjects.
tail_contract.within_frame_p95: For every frame take point-distance P95, then median across frames per subject, then mean across subjects.

rendered_depth_contract: Per frame median absolute Z residual on mesh-covered observed pixels; median across frames per subject; arithmetic mean across subjects. Coverage is the median of per-subject median coverage.
sampling_correction: Postmortem scoring freezes the same point indices for Official and E1-E10. Fourteen of fifteen VAL frames contain at most 25,000 points and therefore already use all points; only one VAL frame is sampling-sensitive.
